notes: All 11 confirmed intents across 4 DDD layers were translated into 11 NUnit test methods in 8 test fixture files. Domain layer tests cover Building constructor and IBuildingListRepository contract. Application layer tests cover IBuildingListService contract and BuildingListService behavior for populated and empty repositories. Infrastructure layer tests cover SqlBuildingListRepository.GetAllBuildingsAsync with mock DbContext for populated and empty data sets. Presentation layer tests cover BuildingDto, GetBuildingListResponse records, and GetBuildingListHandler behavior for populated and empty service results.
